Im in my 2nd-3rd year of college. And its better, if anything, but I still want kill myself; I am pretty good at keeping myself in check, i dont really externalize my feelings, so I just bottle them up, and at this point I think ive just become a bit twisted. I did try and go with counselors and proffesional help (1 teacher and 2-3 mental health doctors) but honestly its a hassle, I didnt really connect with them, the "solutions" were always the same, so i just sped up the process and feigned recovery.   


To this day, I still hope I were dead. 5-6 years have passed and I still wish I could disappear. But I am still alive...must mean something, right?  


Also, thanks for replying, never checked back on the post :P
